name: Sent: threads, like email
author: wizard
description: Chats › Sent lists threads, not each thing you sent: one row per thread, the same row as Inbox (its title, avatar or tag, last message, time), under Working while it runs and Processed when done. A thread is in Inbox when it needs you and in Sent otherwise, never in both. What you sent into a thread is in the thread and in the row's actions (hold, swipe left, right-click or Shift+F10), with the two routing corrections.
